recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-40585; any future changes to external Clinical Genomics incubator artifacts should be handled by a new issue in that artifact stream.
issue_request: FHIR-40585 was Published as Persuasive for R5. It requested updating the FMM level on GenomicStudy artifacts to 1 and applying text corrections found for MolecularSequence and GenomicStudy.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to HL7/fhir#2809 and HL7/fhir#2814. PR #2809 was applied by de44b1258bd1dd32dec8c0f41060bd62d2c31be3 and merged as f8aba0f2bf8ea234298c48e0b6a3dbc6c53652f8, changing GenomicStudy resource, CodeSystem, and ValueSet fmm extensions from 0 to 1. PR #2814 was applied by 9a1068d36762e9e32d6a56f3ce24808027bafe2e and merged as 4ff281120d3d82e4e637df66a53fcdb43bf30ffc, correcting GenomicStudy narrative/definition wording and MolecularSequence introduction/notes wording.
additional_context: Current core source keeps retained GenomicStudy FMM values at 1 and active diagnostics narrative says GenomicStudy is FMM=1. MolecularSequence has no current source directory; source/fhir.ini comments out MolecularSequence workgroup/security entries and tracks MolecularDefinition, while diagnostics narrative says MolecularSequence was replaced by MolecularDefinition with Clinical Genomics incubator links. The already-published FHIR-51227 reconciliation is later context for that replacement.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The original R5 fixes are present in source history and current retained/core narrative, and reapplying MolecularSequence text corrections would target a deleted/out-of-current-build resource rather than the current MolecularDefinition/CG-incubator direction.
